subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should Telegram topic close/reopen be enabled like create/edit while permanent `topic-delete` is a separately named, default-off action requiring explicit operator configuration?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but repository policy makes destructive defaults and authorization behavior a product/security choice rather than an implementation detail.

options.title: Ship gated full lifecycle
options.body: Add close and reopen using the established topic-action pattern, plus a separately named default-off delete action with explicit destructive documentation and permission checks.

options.title: Defer permanent deletion
options.body: Add only reversible close and reopen now, leaving deletion for a separately sponsored security and UX decision.

options.title: Keep create and edit only
options.body: Decline further lifecycle actions and continue requiring Telegram administrators to archive or delete topics manually.

recommendation.title: Ship gated full lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add close and reopen using the established topic-action pattern, plus a separately named default-off delete action with explicit destructive documentation and permission checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The topic-edit commit is the nearest merged precedent for the remaining lifecycle actions and spans the same shared and Telegram-owned surfaces.
